articles.title: Nvidia’s $1.5 Trillion Roller Coaster: Affairs, Espionage Allegations, GTA 6 Memes and Jensen Huang’s Extraordinary Comeback
articles.subtitle: An admitted affair, allegations involving Chinese intelligence, a dramatic resignation, and one of the most remarkable CEO comebacks in recent technology history. In less than three weeks, Nvidia lost approximately $1.47 trillion in market value before recovering nearly $1 trillion in a single trading session. And somehow, GTA 6 became part of the conversation.
articles.excerpt: An admitted affair, national security allegations, an extraordinary resignation and a nearly $1 trillion comeback. HCG News examines the numbers behind Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia and separates the facts from the GTA 6 memes.
